title: Honkaku Shougi Shinan: Wakamatsu Shougi Juku
native_title: 本格将棋指南 若松将棋塾
overview:
Before I knew it, I had become stronger than my father.

I will guide you carefully, from beginner to advanced.

- Standard two-player games and games against the computer are of course included!
- Beginners can level up while having fun with Wakamatsu-sensei's "Shogi School Mode"!
- Advanced players can sharpen their skills further with three-player play and blindfold mode!
- You can also finely adjust settings such as strength and handicaps.

The definitive authentic shogi software!

いつのまにか父より強くなっていた。

初心者から上級者まで丁寧に指導いたします。

★通常の二人対局や、コンピュータ対局はもちろん装備!
★初心者には、若松先生の「将棋塾モード」で、楽しみながら、レベルアップ!
★上級者は、3人指しや、目隠しモードで、実力をより確かなモノに!
★その他、強さ、ハンディなどを細かく設定できます。

本格将棋ソフトの決定版!
